notes: Supplier agreements: the generated screen showed the SUPPLIER file (wrong); corrected to ST_SUPP_AGRMNT with its suppliers (ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_SUPP) and items (ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_DET). Legacy rules: dates, one agreement per manufacturer / contract type and period, approval levels (USERS.SUPP_AGRMNT_APPROVAL), end-date change right (EDIT_AGRMNT_DATE), line derivations, copy and load-items buttons (APP_RULES3_PR) Wave 3b: STOP_FLAG check box; legacy LOVs (suppliers of the agreement's manufacturer, active groups, active items with a basic unit of the group, units of the item) as cascading lists.

row_rules.ST_SUPP_AGRMNT:
-- approval level only through the approve / cancel buttons; changing the end date needs USERS.EDIT_AGRMNT_DATE
app_rules3_pr.agrmnt_row(inserting, :new.approve, :old.approve, :new.end_date, :old.end_date, :new.stop_flag);
row_rules.ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_SUPP:
-- legacy supplier LOV: active suppliers of the agreement's manufacturer (VN_SUPP_KIND)
app_rules3_pr.agrmnt_supp_row(:new.serial, :new.supplier_code);
row_rules.ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_DET:
-- legacy line WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM: item with a basic unit, group, unit, sales price and MOH discount of the item,
-- non-negative values, ratios 0..100, bonus / discount pairs, basic quantity
app_rules3_pr.agrmnt_det_row(inserting, :new.serial, :new.group_code, :new.item_code, :new.unit_code, :new.supplier_code,
  :new.quantity, :old.quantity, :new.basic_qty, :new.sales_price, :old.sales_price,
  :new.bonus_ratio, :old.bonus_ratio, :new.bonus, :old.bonus, :new.extra_bonus_ratio, :old.extra_bonus_ratio, :new.extra_bonus, :old.extra_bonus,
  :new.disc1_ratio, :old.disc1_ratio, :new.disc1_value, :old.disc1_value, :new.disc2_ratio, :old.disc2_ratio, :new.disc2_value, :old.disc2_value,
  :new.disc3_ratio, :old.disc3_ratio, :new.disc3_value, :old.disc3_value, :new.m_disc_ratio, :new.m_disc_value, :new.item_name_dummy);

ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_SUPP.SUPPLIER_CODE.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.supplier_status, 0) = 1 and (s.code in (select k.supp_code from vn_supp_kind k where k.kind_code = (select a.kind_code from st_supp_agrmnt a where a.serial = :PAGE_SERIAL)) or not exists (select 1 from vn_supp_kind k where k.kind_code = (select a.kind_code from st_supp_agrmnt a where a.serial = :PAGE_SERIAL))) order by 2

ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_DET.GROUP_CODE.lov: select item_group_code || ' - ' || name_a d, item_group_code r from st_item_group where nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and group_status = 1 order by 2

ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it, st_item_unit iu where (it.item_group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and it.item_group_code = iu.group_code and it.item_code = iu.item_code and nvl(iu.basic_unit, 0) = 1 order by 2

ST_SUPP_AGRMNT_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE and iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

params.lov_sql: select kind_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(name_e, name_a), name_a) d, kind_code r from st_good_kind order by 2
